_about: Synthetic Russian set for learnable-fact extraction. No real personal data. gold: [group, [value prefixes that must appear in the fact text]]. Groups: name, address, address_form, home_city, hometown, occupation, languages, pet, language_pref, answer_length, preference, rule. Empty gold = nothing must be learned.
